scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.dev:graphics: cd Graphics && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:go" "npm run dev:graphics"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:prep && npm run build:go
scripts.build:prep: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force server-go/dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item -Recurse frontend/dist server-go/dist"
